headline: Experiences, from entry to detail
overview: Experiences invites you to step into philosophical dilemmas and moral scenarios as a character, making choices that reveal something about your values, instincts, and worldview. Each experience is a short interactive narrative where your decisions matter — there are no right answers, only honest ones. Afterward, you can reflect on what your choices say about you.
targetAudience: Users interested in spirituality tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Interactive philosophical dilemma scenarios with meaningful choices
Character-driven narratives that put you in morally complex situations
Post-experience reflections to explore what your choices reveal about your values
History of completed experiences and the decisions you made
tips: Choose instinctively on your first read — overthinking tends to mask your genuine values
Revisit the reflection section after completing an experience to deepen your self-understanding
